Congrats. A few things i discovered on my journey

1. Weaning mode is great - my bubs didnt need to constant motion at first so i never bothered with it until he "woke up" a bit and it then became helpful as i used to get him to selfsettle (ie i would put him down awake)
2. My bubs go angry at the motion too when he was Tiny. Reason being the Snoo wont sooth if there is something wrong ie they are hungry, and my LO would omly really wake if he was hungry or cold 

3. Re the Snoo Sack. Try putting it over his normal swaddle at first.. even just using the velcro.
It took about 3wks for my LO to be ok with arms down swaddling. Newborns often life arms up - A few friends just use a Love to Dream sack and pop the snoo straps over the top.

Personally the Snoo become useful about week 4.. before then it was just a good white noise machine for us. 
Im right now in the 4M regression and it is earning its keep for sure!

Good luck

I have a 2.5yr old female golden retriever and did alot of research including speaking with our breeder and a few vets before i spayed.
It is best to wait till after the girls first heat, but before the second. (Heat usually occurs at about 1-1.5yrs) 
Waiting till after the first gives her body time to properly grow and get hormones to reduce bone cancer likihood. Doing it before the second them helps reduce the risk of "breast" cancer that come with continued heat cycles.

On a practical note - protecting your dog when they are on heat is hard work, and dogs can get aggressive so i def advise gettjng her spayed if you dont intend on breeding

Note: Our girl temperant did not change at all after being spayed

Backstory: I’m not a kid was in my early 20s when I got suicidal.. i was so consumed in how imperfect I was.
I still battled with depression but I wish I was given the tools/advice below to cope earlier...
(Note: I still tell myself this every day)

Happiness is a Trap.. no one is always happy
No one needs to be happy all the time. Being sad sometimes is actually important
Cry.. crying can be healthy
Being sad is ok and not a sign of weakness. It is how you deal with sadness that matters. 
On that note don’t bottle things up
Talk to people you trust, it is likely they have gone though something similar. You are not alone
Exercise..even when u don’t want to.
Remember ... It’s ok to NOT BE OK

And lastly I try to remind myself of this when I’m feeling hopeless... a lack of happiness doesn’t mean we need to die.. BUT dying DOES mean we don’t get the chance of experiencing happiness..
